fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Introduction Editor Notes: After 4-years' study, students will be elites in the petroleum field. Become a petroleum professional with extensive basic theoretical knowledge, solid practical application capabilities, who can engage in engineering design, reservoir engineering design, production and construction, site management, international cooperation, and scientific research in the field of petroleum engineering. 2. Main Courses Editor Notes: The courses list below are mainly like by students. Oil and Gas Development Geology Reservoir Engineering Drilling Engineering Log Interpretation and Production Logging 3. Research areas Editor Notes: Two research areas are provided for students. Oil and Natural Gas Drilling, Developing, and Ocean Engineering 4. School Introduction Editor Notes: CUPB is in a leading position in the petroleum and petrochemical disciplines in China. China University of Petroleum, Beijing Campus (CUPB) , is located in a scenic region of tourist interest in Changping County, Beijing, about 5 miles to the Ming Tombs and 15 miles to the Great Wall. CUPB offers not only engineering programs in oil and gas science including chemical engineering, petroleum engineering, geoscience and mechanical and electronic engineering, but also, in computer science, business management and Chinese Language Study programs of a full range from diploma, bachelor's and master's to doctoral programs. Learn More>> 5. Colourful Life Editor Notes: There are a variety kind of activities international students can choose to take part in. Opening Ceremony Visited the 7th Beijing Agricultural Carnival

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Physical Examination Report (With all lab and X-ray test reports) * 2. English proficiency certificate Note: If you do not have IELTS or TOEFL, please provide an official certificate issued by your high school which should certify that the medium of instruction in your high school study is English. * 3. Non-Criminal Record Certificate * 4. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . * 5. Photocopy of your Passport home page With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included * 6. Passport photo Soft copy of your passport photo with blue background, photo size 480*720, JPG format(uploaded as application material) * 7. Official transcripts of your grades in high school and translated copies in Chinese or English version The average score is more than 70% and GPA 3.0/5.0 above. * 8. High School Diploma and translated copy in Chinese or English version. If you have not graduated yet, please get in touch with your current school to provide a ‘certificate’ of expected graduation. Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Nationality Should be a non-Chinese citizen who can study and live in the school in good health and with a sound mind. If both or one of the applicant’s parents is a Chinese citizen and resides in a foreign country, the applicant has foreign nationality at birth. In that case, they do not have Chinese nationality and must have a record of actually living abroad for more than 2 years within the last 4 years. (Nine (9) months living abroad are equivalent to one year, subject to entry and exit visas).Chinese emigrants who apply to come to China for undergraduate study as international students must hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for more than 4 years. Within the 4 years, they must have a record of living abroad for more than 2 years (9 months abroad in a year can be calculated as one year, subject to entry and exit visas). 2. Education Background Must be at the high school level or above, with a high school diploma. 3. Language Requirements English-taught Programs: Must be an English native speaker or come from countries with English as the official language; otherwise, should provide a valid English proficiency certificate such as IELTS≥6.0, TOEFL≥75, or TOEFL Essentials≥8 (DI Code: 806). 4. Applicants should be friendly to China, law-abiding, without any criminal records.
